Hi Laura — thanks for sending these over. Quick confirmation items so we can process on our side: 

1) Is ACH the preferred payment method for all future invoices? If you accept wire for urgent payments please indicate wire routing as well.
2) For security, can you confirm the full account name exactly as it appears on bank records (you listed Acme Distribution LLC — good to confirm).
3) We need a signed Vendor Change form with a printed name and title in the signature block (I see the form attached but please confirm it’s signed by an authorized signer).

I’ve cc’d Karthik (Finance) and Marissa (Procurement) to expedite. Once Finance confirms the supporting docs we’ll: 
- Create/update supplier record in ERP
- Update PO routing/remit-to on upcoming POs
- Note effective date 2026-04-01 in the supplier profile

Expect an update from Finance within 48 business hours after we receive the signed form. If you can also send a voided check (if ACH) or bank letter, that will speed verification.

Best,
Kimberly Park
